name: Chess Grandmaster
tagline: Full-strength Stockfish, running offline inside the sandbox.
description:
The real engine — Stockfish 18 with its NNUE evaluation net embedded — compiled to WebAssembly and bundled inside the GIF. Not a JavaScript reimplementation, and not a server: the app instantiates the engine from bytes it already carries, so it never touches the network. It plays on a plane.

Pick your level on a ladder from about 1320 Elo up through Grandmaster, plus a top rung that removes the leash entirely — objectively stronger than any human alive. Every search reports the engine's win / draw / loss odds alongside a centipawn evaluation and the best line it has found, and the whole coaching layer toggles off for a distraction-free game.

Hints only ever appear when you press Hint. Take-backs, resign and a promotion picker are all there. Finished games are saved into the icon so you can step through any of them move by move, and your game in progress auto-saves — close the tab, come back, resume.

Or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices.
